description: PARKED BY OPERATOR (2026-10-26): UltraBlade 2 is a PC-only game for this milestone. The earlier work proved Android Build Support installs, a signed debug APK builds/installs/launches on an API 35 emulator, on-device markers fire and an in-app framebuffer capture exists; clear world rendering on the emulator Vulkan surface is limited and the mobile target is not part of the playable release or claimed complete.
checks: Android Build Support installed and debug APK builds
APK installs and launches on the API 35 emulator
on-device UBLADE2_START / UBLADE_HERO_OK / GYPSY_DEMO_OK markers captured
in-app framebuffer capture exists (HUD/controls clear, world dark under emulator Vulkan)
mobile is parked by operator decision and is not part of the PC-only playable release
notes: Operator decision 2026-10-26: PC only for now; mobile work is retained for a future pass and must not be cited as a completed mobile release.
The mobile toolpack/slice remain valid infrastructure for that future pass.
